result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Add a new film entry, with optional TMDB lookup

USAGE:
    filmstruck add [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information                    
    -t, --title <TITLE>              Film title for TMDB search                 
    -d, --date <DATE>                Watch date in M/d/yyyy format (default:    
                                     today)                                     
    -l, --location <LOCATION>        Where the film was watched                 
    -c, --companions <COMPANIONS>    Comma-separated list of companions         
        --default-poster             Use the default/first poster without       
                                     prompting                                  
        --tmdb-id <ID>               TMDB movie ID (skips search and            
                                     confirmation)                              
        --no-tmdb                    Add the film without TMDB metadata or a    
                                     poster
